title: trollius macropetalus
intro: Trollius macropetalus, commonly known as the Large-flowered Globe-flower, is a perennial plant species native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to alleviate various health issues, boasting health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Trollius macropetalus include its ability to reduce fever, ease pain, and promote wound healing, making it a valuable resource in natural remedies. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
